test_cases.title: Fresh graph startup with bundled BFO
test_cases.preconditions: Clean system state, no existing graph. Bundled BFO Turtle file is accessible.
steps: Observe the initialization logs and network activity.
test_cases.expected_result: BFO auto-ingests successfully with zero network calls. Navigation tree populates with BFO concepts.

test_cases.title: Deterministic IRI minting from source IRI
test_cases.preconditions: System is running. BFO is ingested.
steps: Identify the minted Fandaws IRI for a specific source class (e.g., 'Entity').
Trigger a re-ingestion of the same source class.
Compare the resulting Fandaws IRI with the original.
test_cases.expected_result: The Fandaws IRI remains identical (uuid5-derived). No duplicates are created.

test_cases.title: Ingest a named class with parent hierarchy
test_cases.preconditions: Ontology file contains a class with a named superclass.
steps: Query the graph for the child class properties.
test_cases.expected_result: Concept is created. Labels map correctly. Both skos:broader and rdfs:subClassOf point to the same Fandaws parent IRI. owl:equivalentClass is an array containing the source IRI.

test_cases.title: Root class ingestion
test_cases.preconditions: Ontology file contains a class with no superclass (e.g., BFO 'Entity').
steps: Inspect the root node in the tree panel.
test_cases.expected_result: Concept is created as a root node with no skos:broader or parent references.

test_cases.title: User concept under imported parent
test_cases.preconditions: BFO is successfully ingested.
steps: Via UI, create a new user concept.
Via conversational input: 'An organism is a material entity'.
test_cases.expected_result: skos:broader and rdfs:subClassOf on the user concept correctly point to the imported parent's Fandaws IRI. No raw bfo: IRIs appear on the user concept's rdfs:subClassOf or skos:broader.

test_cases.title: Read-only guard on imported concepts
test_cases.preconditions: Graph contains imported BFO concepts.
steps: Select an imported concept in the UI.
Attempt to edit its label, definition, or properties.
test_cases.expected_result: UI blocks the edit action and displays a prompt suggesting the creation of a subclass instead.

test_cases.title: Preservation of legacy user changes
test_cases.preconditions: Synthetic fixture — restrictions seeded directly on the imported concept, bypassing the read-only guard. This tests defensive re-ingestion resilience per Section 2.2.
steps: Trigger a re-ingestion/update of the source ontology.
Query the previously modified imported concept.
test_cases.expected_result: User-added restrictions and relationships remain intact and are not overwritten by the re-ingestion.

test_cases.title: Label change upstream
test_cases.preconditions: A v2 ontology file exists where a class label has been updated.
steps: Check the concept's IRI and labels.
test_cases.expected_result: IRI remains unchanged. rdfs:label and skos:prefLabel are updated to match v2. owl:equivalentClass remains unchanged (same source IRI, same array). fandaws:contentHash updates to reflect the new source file.

test_cases.title: Class removed upstream
test_cases.preconditions: A v2 ontology file exists with a previously existing class completely removed.
steps: Ensure user concepts exist as children of the target class.
test_cases.expected_result: Concept is not deleted. It is marked with 'fandaws:upstreamStatus' as deprecated. User concepts that were children of the deprecated concept retain their skos:broader pointing to the deprecated concept's Fandaws IRI. The deprecated concept remains navigable in the tree — it is not hidden or collapsed differently from other imported concepts.

test_cases.title: Translation of labels, definitions, and alt labels
test_cases.preconditions: Source contains standard RDFS, SKOS, and OBO annotation properties.
steps: Inspect the resulting Fandaws concept metadata.
test_cases.expected_result: Properties are mapped exactly as specified: rdfs:label/skos:prefLabel for labels, skos:definition for definitions, skos:altLabel preserved.

test_cases.title: Translation of hierarchy to self-contained subclass tree
test_cases.preconditions: Source file has a deep rdfs:subClassOf hierarchy.
steps: Traverse the graph from root to leaf.
test_cases.expected_result: Tree relies entirely on Fandaws parent IRIs. No phantom/unresolvable references exist.

test_cases.title: Non-class axioms from source ontology
test_cases.preconditions: Source contains owl:disjointWith and anonymous restrictions.
steps: Attempt to trigger reasoning logic based on the disjoint axiom.
test_cases.expected_result: Complex axioms are archived in fandaws:sourceAxioms and are explicitly NOT enforced by the core ingestion/reasoning pipeline.

test_cases.title: Verb-to-property exact match
test_cases.preconditions: BFO property 'has part' is ingested.
steps: User asserts a property: 'engine has part piston' (where 'engine' and 'piston' are pre-existing concepts).
test_cases.expected_result: System resolves the relationship. owl:onProperty = bfo:BFO_0000110 (not fandaws:objectProperty/has-part).

test_cases.title: Verb-to-property no match / fallback
test_cases.preconditions: System running normally.
steps: User types a completely novel verb 'consumes'.
test_cases.expected_result: System mints a new local 'fandaws:property/consumes' IRI.

test_cases.title: Verb-label fragility fallback
test_cases.preconditions: Imported property 'has part' exists.
steps: User types punctuation variants ('has_part'), capitalization ('Has Part'), or synonyms ('contains').
test_cases.expected_result: Label fragility causes exact match to fail. System correctly defaults to fallback behavior and mints a local IRI.

test_cases.title: Homonym collision at ingestion
test_cases.preconditions: User graph already contains a concept labeled 'Entity'.
steps: View both concepts in the UI.
test_cases.expected_result: Auto-qualified as 'Entity (bfo)' and 'Entity (user)'. Both carry skos:hiddenLabel: 'Entity'. Subsequent bare 'Entity' input triggers disambiguation prompt via hidden label lookup.

test_cases.title: Imported concept search and display
test_cases.preconditions: BFO is ingested. UI is open.
steps: Check the navigation tree display state.
test_cases.expected_result: Imported concepts appear in search results, possess a visual badge indicating their imported status, and are collapsed in the tree by default.

test_cases.title: Default export with pristine imported ontology included
test_cases.preconditions: Graph contains user concepts and unmodified (pristine) imported concepts.
test_cases.expected_result: Export includes owl:equivalentClass for pristine imports, retains subclass structure, emits owl:imports, and strips internal fandaws metadata.

test_cases.title: Export excluding imported proxy concepts
test_cases.preconditions: Graph contains user concepts linked to imported concepts.
test_cases.expected_result: Imported proxy concepts are entirely absent. Subclass links and user restrictions point directly to the raw source IRIs. owl:imports is present.

test_cases.title: Restriction source fidelity
test_cases.preconditions: Synthetic fixture (or Phase B CCO ontology) where ingested restrictions are seeded directly on a concept, alongside user-created restrictions.
test_cases.expected_result: Restrictions are correctly tagged with 'fandaws:source'. owl:onProperty IRIs remain opaque/unmodified.

test_cases.title: Export relation changes with modified lifecycle (Synthetic Fixture)
test_cases.preconditions: Synthetic database fixture loaded where an imported concept has fandaws:locallyModified set to 'extended' or 'diverged'.
test_cases.expected_result: Extended → each owl:equivalentClass array entry emitted as rdfs:subClassOf triple. Diverged → each entry emitted as skos:closeMatch triple. The internal owl:equivalentClass array is NOT emitted directly. fandaws:locallyModified is NOT in output.

test_cases.title: Performance and batching
test_cases.preconditions: Fresh environment. BFO ontology file is ready.
test_cases.expected_result: Ingestion completes, and indexes are rebuilt, in under 100 ms to meet the spec threshold.

test_cases.title: Migration of pre-ingestion phantom BFO links
test_cases.preconditions: Older graph version contains direct rdfs:subClassOf links to raw BFO IRIs.
test_cases.expected_result: Phantom links are correctly rewritten to point to the new Fandaws-minted imported IRIs using the equivalence index.

test_cases.title: Phase boundary: Out of scope block
test_cases.preconditions: System is running v1.3.
steps: Attempt to configure federated lazy-loading via config/API (if exposed).
test_cases.expected_result: System gracefully ignores or rejects federated import configurations, keeping single-graph scope.

test_cases.title: [Robustness] Error: Malformed source data
test_cases.preconditions: Bundled Turtle file contains invalid syntax.
test_cases.expected_result: System catches parsing error, aborts ingestion gracefully without crashing, logs the error, and initializes the user graph without the broken import.

test_cases.title: [Implementation Hardening] Error: Circular Dependencies
test_cases.preconditions: Source file contains Class A -> subClassOf -> Class B -> subClassOf -> Class A.
test_cases.expected_result: Tree-builder detects the cycle, breaks the infinite loop to prevent a stack overflow, logs a warning, and maps the concepts flatly or stops at the cycle boundary.

test_cases.title: Re-ingestion hash short-circuit
test_cases.preconditions: BFO already ingested.
steps: Re-trigger ingestion with identical BFO file.
test_cases.expected_result: contentHash matches, pipeline skipped entirely, zero mutations, execution time <5ms.

test_cases.title: Existing graph first-open trigger
test_cases.preconditions: Pre-ingestion graph with user concepts referencing bfo:BFO_0000040 in rdfs:subClassOf.
test_cases.expected_result: BFO ingested automatically, phantom references migrated to Fandaws IRIs, user content unchanged.

test_cases.title: Post-qualification disambiguation
test_cases.preconditions: Homonym collision resolved — 'entity (bfo)' and 'entity (user)' exist.
steps: User types 'an organism is an entity'.
test_cases.expected_result: Hidden label lookup finds two matches. Disambiguation prompt fires. User selects 'entity (bfo)'. Organism classified under BFO Entity.

test_cases.title: owl:imports subject IRI
test_cases.preconditions: Graph has imported concepts.
test_cases.expected_result: Export contains fandaws:graph/{graphId} a owl:Ontology ; owl:imports <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/bfo.owl> . Subject IRI matches graph identity. Ontology IRI used, not document URL.

test_cases.title: Unresolved phantom warning
test_cases.preconditions: Graph with rdfs:subClassOf: cco:SomeClass (CCO not ingested).
test_cases.expected_result: CCO reference left unchanged. verifyIntegrity() emits warning (not error). Graph loads successfully.

test_cases.title: Determinism byte-equality
test_cases.preconditions: Access to two clean test environments.
steps: Ingest BFO into two separate fresh graphs.
test_cases.expected_result: Byte-identical serialized output.

test_cases.title: owl:equivalentClass array cardinality
test_cases.preconditions: Fresh environment.
steps: Check owl:equivalentClass on any ingested concept.
test_cases.expected_result: Value is an array (e.g., ["bfo:BFO_0000040"]), not a bare string. The array format survives the roundtrip.
